'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**[[Gaza–Israel conflict]]
***[[May 2023 Gaza–Israel clashes|2023 Gaza–Israel clashes]]
****[[Israel]] launches an [[airstrike]] in the [[Gaza Strip]], killing seven people, including four members of the [[Marxist–Leninism|Marxist–Leninist]] [[Popular Front for the Liberation of Palestine|PFLP]]. In another raid, two [[Islamic Jihad Movement in Palestine|Islamic Jihad Movement]] [[militant]]s are killed by [[Israeli security forces]] in [[Qabatiya]], in the [[West Bank]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/5/10/israeli-palestinian-fighting-ongoing-as-egypt-ceasefire-falters (Al Jazeera)]
****[[Palestinians|Palestinian]] militants fire more than 260 rockets into Israel from [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]] in response to yesterday's airstrikes. Most of the rockets are intercepted by the [[Iron Dome]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-65544214 (BBC News)]
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**One person is killed and four others are injured when a [[car bomb]] [[explode]]s outside a [[police station]] in [[Barzeh, Syria|Barzeh]], [[Damascus]], [[Syria]]. [https://apnews.com/article/syria-damascus-car-explosion-c240dbb5be3ea1477d8fd207653479ca (AP)]
*One person is killed and 30 others injured during protests against repression across [[Senegal]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/5/10/senegal-opposition-leader-calls-for-mass-protest-after-court-ruling (Al Jazeera)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Four people are injured after a magnitude 5.2 [[list of earthquakes in Japan|earthquake]] struck near [[Kisarazu]], [[Chiba Prefecture]], [[Japan]]. [https://english.kyodonews.net/news/2023/05/c9d9160e99ca-urgent-strong-quake-jolts-chiba-tokyo-other-areas.html (Kyodo News)]
*[[2023 Taichung crane collapse]]
**One passenger is killed and ten others are injured when a [[Taichung Metro|metro]] train collides with a fallen [[tower crane]] in [[Taichung]], [[Taiwan]]. [https://www.taiwannews.com.tw/en/news/4888633 (''Taiwan News'')]
*[[2023 Africa floods]]
**Ten people are killed in [[Lubero]] and six more are killed at the [[Rubaya mines]], [[North Kivu]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]] during two [[landslide]]s. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/5/10/at-least-sixteen-killed-in-landslide-in-eastern-dr-congo (Al Jazeera)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Poland–Russia relations]]
**The [[Polish Committee for Standardization]] adopts a resolution suggesting that all [[government of Poland|government]] documents relating to the [[Russia]]n [[semi-exclave]] [[Kaliningrad Oblast]] use the Polish name Królewiec Oblast. The name is taken from the place's Polish name from the fourteenth century. Russia objects to the change, characterizing the move as a "hostile act". [https://www.pap.pl/en/news/news%2C1570624%2Cpoland-use-name-krolewiec-instead-kaliningrad.html (Polish Press Agency)] [https://www.thetimes.co.uk/article/russia-angered-by-polands-renaming-of-kaliningrad-exclave-9p0xwxzhr (''The Times'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Censorship in Russia]]
**A court in [[Tver Oblast]], Russia, [[sentence (law)|sentences]] a poet to four years in prison for reciting [[poetry]] critical of the [[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]. [https://www.rferl.org/a/russia-poets-prison-antiwar-verses/32405203.html (RFE/RL)]
*One person is killed and nine others are injured in a [[mass stabbing]] in [[Tomisławice, Łódź Voivodeship|Tomisławice]], [[Łódź Voivodeship]], [[Poland]]. [https://apnews.com/article/knife-attack-poland-orphanage-41d7b7f253329fbd363a2bf6821cd373 (AP)]
*[[Mexican drug war]]
**Four people are killed during clashes at the [[Pharr–Reynosa International Bridge]], on the [[Mexico–United States border]], between police and suspected cartel members. [https://www.mirror.co.uk/news/us-news/breaking-mexico-border-shooting-heavy-29949522 (Mirror)]
*[[United States House of Representatives|U.S. Representative]] [[George Santos]] is charged with 13 counts of fraud and other [[financial crime]]s and is taken into custody. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/national-security/2023/05/10/george-santos-charges/ (''The Washington Post'')]
*[[Hong Kong]]'s [[Legislative Council of Hong Kong|Legislative Council]] passes a law requiring foreign lawyers working on national security cases to obtain prior approval from the [[Chief Executive of Hong Kong|Chief Executive]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/hong-kong-restricts-foreign-lawyers-national-security-cases-2023-05-10/ (Reuters)]
